India's Insurance Sector Sees Growing Interest in Foreign Investment

The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) has received its first applications under the 100% foreign direct investment (FDI) regime. This development is expected to bring more foreign insurers into the market, which could potentially lead to lower premiums for Indian consumers.
